groups.name: meili.index
groups.description: Startup-time index initialization and settings-sync policy.

properties.name: meili.url
properties.description: MeiliSearch service base URL, including scheme. Connect and read timeouts are intentionally not configurable (the official SDK client builds its HTTP transport internally).

properties.name: meili.api-key
properties.description: API key (master or derived); empty means unauthenticated. Keep it out of version control - inject via environment or config server.

values.description: No index interaction at startup; the server must already be provisioned.
Create missing indexes with full settings push; existing indexes are only diffed and reported.
Diff projected settings against existing indexes and apply the on-settings-drift strategy.
Log the drifted keys; change nothing.
Push the projected settings (filterable/sortable drift triggers a server-side full rebuild).
Fail startup with a mapping exception without writing anything.
